# RISK REVIEW CHECKLIST FOR LAWYERS

**Matter:** ___________________________  
**Document:** ___________________________  
**Reviewer:** ___________________________  
**Date:** ___________________________

---

## PRE-REVIEW VERIFICATION

- [ ] Confirm document is complete and final version
- [ ] Verify all pages are legible and OCR accurate
- [ ] Check document metadata (date, parties, version)
- [ ] Confirm correct matter association

---

## COMMERCIAL & FINANCIAL REVIEW

- [ ] Price/fee certainty and calculation method clear
- [ ] Payment terms reasonable (Net 30-60 preferred)
- [ ] Retention/withholding provisions acceptable
- [ ] Interest on late payment specified
- [ ] Currency and FX risk addressed
- [ ] Change order/variation process defined
- [ ] Security/collateral requirements reasonable

---

## SCOPE & PERFORMANCE

- [ ] Deliverables clearly specified
- [ ] Acceptance criteria defined
- [ ] Performance standards/KPIs measurable
- [ ] Quality standards appropriate
- [ ] Design responsibility allocated

---

## TIME & DELAY

- [ ] Completion date realistic
- [ ] Extension of Time (EOT) grounds fair
- [ ] EOT procedure workable
- [ ] Liquidated damages (LDs) reasonable and enforceable
- [ ] Force majeure clause adequate

---

## LIABILITY & RISK ALLOCATION

- [ ] Indemnities scope acceptable
- [ ] Liability caps present and reasonable
- [ ] Exclusions for consequential loss
- [ ] Insurance requirements appropriate
- [ ] Warranties limited and specific

---

## TERM & EXIT

- [ ] Initial term clear
- [ ] Renewal mechanism defined
- [ ] Termination for convenience available
- [ ] Termination for cause with cure period
- [ ] Survival clauses identified
- [ ] Exit/handover obligations clear

---

## COMPLIANCE & REGULATORY (UGANDA)

- [ ] Licensing/permits addressed
- [ ] Data privacy (DPA 2019) compliance
- [ ] AML/KYC requirements met
- [ ] Tax obligations clear
- [ ] Sector-specific regulations considered

---

## PROPERTY/LAND (if applicable)

- [ ] Title verification completed
- [ ] Encumbrances disclosed
- [ ] Block/plot references accurate
- [ ] Boundaries/survey confirmed
- [ ] Easements/rights of way identified
- [ ] Ground rent/rates current

---

## DISPUTE RESOLUTION

- [ ] Governing law specified (Uganda preferred)
- [ ] Jurisdiction/forum appropriate
- [ ] Arbitration/mediation clause present
- [ ] Escalation procedure defined
- [ ] Legal costs allocation addressed

---

## IP & CONFIDENTIALITY

- [ ] IP ownership clear
- [ ] License scope defined
- [ ] Confidentiality obligations mutual
- [ ] Duration appropriate
- [ ] Carve-outs reasonable

---

## COUNTERPARTY DUE DILIGENCE

- [ ] Party identity verified
- [ ] Authority to sign confirmed
- [ ] Corporate good standing checked
- [ ] Guarantees/sureties if needed
- [ ] Solvency concerns addressed

---

## DRAFTING QUALITY

- [ ] Defined terms consistent
- [ ] No internal contradictions
- [ ] All schedules/annexes attached
- [ ] Cross-references accurate
- [ ] Plain English, no ambiguity
- [ ] Uganda legal context appropriate

---

## FINAL CONCLUSION

**Overall Assessment:**  
[ ] APPROVE - Proceed with execution  
[ ] APPROVE WITH MINOR CHANGES - List below  
[ ] NEGOTIATE - Material issues require resolution  
[ ] REJECT - Fundamental problems

**Key Issues to Address:**
1. _________________________________
2. _________________________________
3. _________________________________

**Recommended Actions:**
_____________________________________________
_____________________________________________
_____________________________________________

**Date:** ___________________

**Note:** This checklist supplements but does not replace professional legal judgment. All conclusions must be documented in the risk report system.
